name.description: Kebab-case component name. Defaults to the dasherized node id.

path.description: Destination directory within the application source tree. Defaults to the application app directory.

project.description: The target Angular application project. Required when the workspace has multiple applications.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles a Tabs node (uses.selectedIndex, uses.orientation, produces.selectedTabChange) with tab children (uses.label, uses.disabled); the content of each tab is compiled and embedded.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID within the OpenUI document to compile. When omitted, targets the first Tabs element.
